pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Early morning in a broad stone square inside the rebuilt walls of ancient Jerusalem, by a great arched gate. A vast crowd of men, women and older children in robes of every color gathers, standing shoulder to shoulder, faces turned toward the middle. Soft gold dawn light, deep blue shadows, a sense of a people together.
